name: @aos/meta-organic-connector
description: AAOS Meta Organic Connector — publishes organic content to Facebook Pages and Instagram Business accounts via Meta's Graph API (POST /{page-id}/feed, POST /{ig-user-id}/media + /media_publish) and reads back post/media insights. A separate composition root from @aos/meta-ads-connector (which talks to Meta's Marketing API for paid ads) — different permission model, different endpoints, different trust boundary.
